row.evidence: Outreach's Okta provisioning guide says "This feature is available for specific Account Plans only. Please contact your sales representative for more information."
row.notes: Unchanged from June (gated). Pricing moved to outreach.ai/pricing: four Amplify packages (Essentials, Core, Plus, Pro), all 'Request pricing', seat plus AI-credit based. June's '$100-160/u/mo' estimate had no first-party source and is dropped. SCIM 2.0 at api.outreach.io/scim/v2/{org_id} uses OAuth 2.0 (2-hour tokens); only an Okta catalogue SCIM app exists (no Entra gallery app); users cannot be deleted, only locked, which frees the seat. Which packages include SCIM or SAML SSO is not published.

auth.token_source: OAuth 2.0 authorization flow with an Outreach application (scopes users.all, users.aggregate, teams.all, profiles.all, roles.all, scim); Okta app uses 'Authenticate with Outreach' with the Org ID

deprovision.data_retained: User is locked (active=false), which removes login access; users cannot be deleted, and seats are not removed outright.

pagination.notes: ServiceProviderConfig reports filter maxResults 1000; pagination parameters are not documented.

custom.how: Outreach extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:outreach:2.0:User with profileName, roleName and custom<N> fields

roles.how: Extension attributes profileName and roleName assign existing Outreach profiles and roles; profiles and roles must be created in Outreach first.

rate_limits.text: Same limits as the Outreach REST API (10,000 requests/hour per user); some SCIM requests count as multiple requests.

limitations.text: User DELETE is not supported; deprovision by setting active=false (lock).
User filters limited to userName eq and externalId eq; PATCH supports only 'replace' with simple attribute paths.
No Entra gallery app for SCIM; auth is OAuth 2.0 with 2-hour access tokens rather than a long-lived bearer token.
The Okta SCIM app is separate from the custom SAML SSO app and cannot be combined.
Protocol document is marked as subject to change until Beta is complete.

scim.notes: Article says the protocol is subject to change until Beta is complete.

rate_limits.text: 10,000 requests per hour per user; 429 when exceeded.

user_api.notes: JSON:API REST API with OAuth 2.0. Plan availability of the API is not stated; pricing lists API call quotas per package (250,000 to 1,000,000 API calls).

okta.notes: OIN page marks SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking (page markup); SAML SSO uses a separate custom SAML app.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery app for SCIM; Outreach points to its OAuth SCIM API. SAML SSO is documented with Azure.

onelogin.notes: Outreach's OneLogin guide uses the generic SAML Test Connector; no OneLogin provisioning documented.
